title: Fresh & Ready Foods LLC / FreshRealm: 98 Recall Actions and a Deadly Listeria Crisis
excerpt: Two ready-to-eat food manufacturers — Fresh & Ready Foods LLC and FreshRealm Inc. — triggered 98 recall actions tied to Listeria monocytogenes contamination. Together, the outbreaks sickened 38 people, hospitalized 37, and killed 8 across 19 states.
